rules.name: Search Engine Discovery of Sensitive Content
rules.description: Detects search engine crawlers accessing sensitive paths like /admin, /.env, /.git, /wp-admin, /backup, /config
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "search" or Message contains "engine" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-001

rules.name: Web Server Fingerprinting via Headers
rules.description: Detects verbose server headers disclosing technology stack versions enabling targeted attacks
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "web" or Message contains "server" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-002

rules.name: Application Architecture Fingerprinting
rules.description: Detects reconnaissance of application architecture through technology-specific error pages and headers
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "application" or Message contains "architecture" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-003

rules.name: Directory Listing Exposure
rules.description: Detects directory listing responses exposing file structure and sensitive files
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "directory" or Message contains "listing" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-004

rules.name: Metadata and Source Code Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to metadata files and source code repositories exposing implementation details
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "metadata" or Message contains "source" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-005

rules.name: Error Message Information Disclosure
rules.description: Detects verbose error messages leaking stack traces, database details, or internal paths
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "error" or Message contains "message" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-006

rules.name: Sensitive Data in URL Parameters
rules.description: Detects sensitive data such as tokens, passwords, and PII transmitted in URL query parameters
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "sensitive" or Message contains "data" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-007

rules.name: HTTP Methods Allowed — Verbose OPTIONS Response
rules.description: Detects HTTP OPTIONS responses revealing dangerous methods like PUT, DELETE, TRACE, or DEBUG
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "http" or Message contains "methods" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-008

rules.name: CORS Wildcard Origin Misconfiguration
rules.description: Detects CORS headers with wildcard origins or origin reflection enabling cross-origin data theft
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "cors" or Message contains "wildcard" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-009

rules.name: Content Security Policy Missing or Weak
rules.description: Detects responses missing Content-Security-Policy headers or with overly permissive CSP directives
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "content" or Message contains "security" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-010

rules.name: Security Headers Missing (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options)
rules.description: Detects responses missing critical security headers like Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "security" or Message contains "headers" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-011

rules.name: Subdomain Takeover via CNAME
rules.description: Detects dangling CNAME records pointing to unclaimed external services enabling subdomain takeover
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "subdomain" or Message contains "takeover" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-012

rules.name: Cloud Storage Bucket Enumeration
rules.description: Detects enumeration of cloud storage buckets (S3, GCS, Azure Blob) for data exposure
rules.query: StorageBlobLogs | where OperationName contains "cloud" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), AccountName, ObjectKey | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-013

rules.name: API Documentation Exposure (Swagger/OpenAPI)
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to API documentation endpoints like /swagger, /api-docs, /openapi.json
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "api" or Message contains "documentation" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-014

rules.name: Debug Mode and Test Endpoints Exposed
rules.description: Detects access to debug endpoints, test pages, or development tools left in production
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "debug" or Message contains "mode" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-015

rules.name: Default Credentials on Network Devices
rules.description: Detects login attempts using default credentials on network devices, firewalls, and routers
rules.query: CommonSecurityLog| where DestinationIP !startswith "10." and SourceIP !startswith "10."| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP, DestinationIP | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-016

rules.name: User Enumeration via Login Error Messages
rules.description: Detects login error messages that differentiate between invalid username and invalid password
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "enumeration" or Message contains "login" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-017

rules.name: Account Provisioning Without Approval
rules.description: Detects account creation events bypassing approval workflows
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "account" or Message contains "provisioning" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-018

rules.name: Privilege Escalation via Role Assignment
rules.description: Detects unauthorized role elevation during account modification including admin role grants
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "privilege" or Message contains "escalation" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-019

rules.name: SSO Token Replay Attack
rules.description: Detects replay of SAML or OAuth tokens from different source IPs or outside expected time windows
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "sso" or Message contains "token" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-020
